v_wheel_max: motor limit unknown; 0.75 m/s is the fastest speed with no missed hazards in the sandbox speed runs
slip_long: mean longitudinal slip ratio on loose regolith
slip_long_sd: variation of the slip ratio, redrawn every SLIP_TAU seconds
icr_factor: effective / geometric track width when turning (skid-steer ICR expansion)
slip_tau: how long one slip draw lasts
dig_box: excavation zone overlaps the start zone (16.1.1); its size is in the unreadable Figure 9
dump_x: three dump spots along the 2.2 m berm side, used in turn; a spot an obstacle blocks is skipped
dump_clear: gap between the robot's front and the berm box edge at the dump pose
dump_heading: front faces the berm (robot drives in forwards); the team's dump direction is not known
goal_tol: pose accepted at a dig point or the dump pose
berm_tol: dump pose error that counts as on target (scored, not enforced)
cycles: dig -> dump -> dig cycles per mission
leg_timeout: a leg that takes longer counts as failed
